# Rocket Lawyer

> Rocket Lawyer provides AI-powered legal document creation, contract review, and attorney consultation services for individuals and businesses.

Rocket Lawyer offers a comprehensive platform combining automated legal document templates, Rocket Copilot AI assistance, RocketSign e-signatures, and on-demand access to licensed attorneys. The service covers business formation, contracts, real estate, family law, and tax preparation with flexible membership plans.

## Key Topics

- Rocket Copilot (AI Legal Assistant)
- Legal Documents & Templates
- Business Contracts
- LLC Formation & Business Registration
- RocketSign (E-Signatures)
- Contract Review
- Real Estate Documents
- Family Law & Estate Planning
- Non-Disclosure Agreements
- Trademark Registration
- Legal Advice from Attorneys
- Rocket Legal+ Membership
- Tax Preparation (Rocket Tax)
- Group Legal Benefits
- Document Management

- [Rocket Lawyer Homepage](https://www.rocketlawyer.com): Rocket Lawyer homepage: documents, legal advice, business formation

- [Pricing & Membership Plans](https://www.rocketlawyer.com/pricing): Membership plans with document creation, AI assistant, legal consultation
